plugins.name: cookbook-skills
plugins.description: Five portable Agent Skills, each backed by a deterministic gate: doc-coherence (single-source-of-truth for docs), prompt-optimizer (production prompt engineering), skill-review (vet a whole skill folder before you trust it), agent-tracing (trace an agent to the OpenTelemetry GenAI conventions), and eval-harness (build an eval suite that can actually fail).
